answer.why: Both Cresco Labs and MariMed are vertically integrated US multi-state cannabis operators (MSOs). They cultivate cannabis, manufacture branded cannabis products (flower, edibles, vapes/concentrates), sell wholesale to third-party licensed dispensaries, and operate their own retail dispensaries for adult-use and medical consumers. They share the same product set, the same two-sided customer base (B2C consumers + B2B dispensary buyers), the same business model, and the same high regulatory exposure from state cannabis licensing and federal illegality.
